title: "Interactive Dashboard"
format: html
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| label: Install and Load Libraries
#| echo: false
#| message: true
#| warning: true

# Install packages needed and loads libraries

if(!require("shiny"))
  install.packages("shiny")
  library(shiny)

if(!require("DT"))
  install.packages("DT")
  library(DT)

if(!require("DBI"))
  install.packages("DBI")
  library(DBI)

if(!require("RSQLite"))
  install.packages("RSQLite")
  library(RSQLite)

if(!require("ggplot2"))
  install.packages("ggplot2")
  library(ggplot2)

if(!require("plotly"))
  install.packages("plotly")
  library(plotly)

if(!require("dplyr"))
  install.packages("dplyr")
  library(dplyr)

if(!require("dplyr"))
  install.packages("bslib")
  library(bslib)

# Connect to database
conn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "virtual_production.db")

# Gets a list of all crew members names
crew_list <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT DISTINCT Name FROM CrewMembers")

# Gets the min and max budget values
budget_info <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT MIN(Budget) AS min_budget, MAX(Budget) AS max_budget FROM Productions")

# Gets the earliest and latest dates
date_info <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT MIN(DATE(EndDate)) AS min_date, MAX(DATE(EndDate)) AS max_date FROM Productions")

# Gets the status values
status_info <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT DISTINCT Status FROM Productions ORDER BY Status")

# Creates and defines the aspects of the UI & # Outlines Bootstrap theme and customises
ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bs_theme(
    version = 5,
    bootswatch = "flatly", 
    base_font = font_google("Roboto"), 
    heading_font = font_google("Montserrat"), 
    primary="#007bff"),
  
  # CSS
  tags$head(
    tags$style(HTML("
  
  h2 {
    background-color: #2c3e51;
    padding: 20px;
    color: white;
    border-radius: 8px;
  }
  h3, h4, h5{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
  }
  h5{
    padding-top: 10px;
    padding-bottom: 10px;
    background-color: #2c3e52;
    color: white;
    border-radius: 8px;
  }
  .select{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .tab-content{
    margin-top:20px;
  }
  .table_style{
    padding: 20px;
    border: 4px solid #2c3e51;
    border-radius: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .dataTables_scroll{
    padding-bottom: 20px;
    padding-top: 20px;
  }
  
  .plot_style{
    padding: 20px;
    border: 4px solid #2c3e51;
    border-radius: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  
  "))
  ),
  
  # Main title
  titlePanel("Virtual Production Dashboard"),
  
  # Creates tabs on the pages, outlines amount of tabs, and inputs for each tab
  tabsetPanel(
    # Data View tab and custom inputs
    tabPanel("Data View",
             icon = icon("table"),
      h3("Explore Database Tables"),
      
    # Dropdown menu with selection
     div(
       class = "select",
      selectInput(
          inputId = "table_select", 
          label = "Select a Table to View:",
          choices = c("Clients", "Productions", "CrewMembers", "Assets"),
          selected = "Clients",
          )
     ),
    # Output to table
    div(
      class = "table_style",
      DTOutput("table_output")
      
    )
      ),
  
    # Plot View tab and custom inputs
    tabPanel("Plot View",
             icon = icon("chart-line"),
      h3("Interactive Visualisations"),
      
    div(
      class = "select",
      radioButtons(
        inputId = "plot_selection",
        label = "Select Plot to View:",
        choices = c("Crew Analysis" = "crew", "Budget Analysis" = "budget"),
        selected = "crew",
        inline = TRUE
        )
      ),
    
      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.plot_selection == 'crew'",
        h5("Crew Member Production Overview"),
      
      
    # Sidebar layout and style for user controls
      sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
          width = 3,
            style = "
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 20px;
            height: 500px;
            padding:20px; 
            border-radius:10px;",
      
    # Dropdown menu with selections
      selectInput(
        inputId = "crew_select", 
        label = "Select Crew Member:",
        choices = crew_list$Name,
        selected = crew_list$Name[1]
    ),
    # Date Range Picker
      dateRangeInput(
        inputId = "date_range",
        label = "Completion Date Range:",
        start= date_info$min_date, 
        end = date_info$max_date
        )
        ),
      
    # Output to plot in main panel section
      mainPanel(
        width = 9,
        div(
          class="plot_style",
          plotlyOutput("crew_plot", height="500px")
        )
      )
    )
  ),
      
  conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.plot_selection == 'budget'",
        h5("Production Budget & Status Analysis"),
      
    # Sidebar layout and style for user controls
      sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
          width = 3,
          style = "
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 20px;
            height: 500px;
            padding:20px; 
            border-radius:10px;",
        
      # Slider input for Budget Range
        sliderInput(
          inputId = "budget_range",
          label = "Budget Range:",
          min = budget_info$min_budget,
          max = budget_info$max_budget,
          value = c(budget_info$min_budget, budget_info$max_budget),
          step = 10000,
        ),
      
      # Checkboxes for Status filter
        checkboxGroupInput(
          inputId = "status_filter", 
          label = "Production Status:",
          choices = status_info$Status,
          selected = status_info$Status,
          inline = FALSE
          )
        ),
        
     # Output to plot in main panel section
        mainPanel(
          width = 9,
          div(
            class="plot_style",
            plotlyOutput("budget_plot", height ="500px")
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )

# Interactive outputs and inputs changes
server <- function(input, output, session){
  
# Creates interactive table 
  output$table_output <- renderDT({
    req(input$table_select)
    df <- dbReadTable(conn, input$table_select)
    datatable(df, options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
  })
  

#---Plot 1 Crew Members and Productions ---
  
output$crew_plot <- renderPlotly({
  req(input$crew_select, input$date_range)
  
  #Build SQL query - this joins the tables and sprintf inserts into the query string
  query <- sprintf(
    "SELECT 
      c.Name AS CrewName,
      p.Title, 
      p.EndDate, 
      p.Budget,
      p.Status
      FROM Productions p
      JOIN ProductionCrew pc ON p.ProductionID = pc.ProductionID
      JOIN CrewMembers c ON pc.CrewID = c.CrewID
      WHERE c.Name = '%s' AND DATE(p.EndDate) BETWEEN '%s' AND '%s'
      ORDER BY p.EndDate ASC", 
      input$crew_select, 
      input$date_range[1], 
      input$date_range[2])
  
  # runs the query
  df <-dbGetQuery(conn, query)
 
  # Creates plot using ggplot 
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = EndDate, y = Budget, text = Title)) +
      geom_point(color = "#007bff", size = 3) + 
      labs(title = paste("Productions for", input$crew_select), 
           x = "Completion Date", y = "Budget") +
      theme_minimal()
  
  # Shows information on hover
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("text", "x", "y"))
  
})

#---Plot 2 Budget and Status---
  
output$budget_plot <- renderPlotly({
  req(input$budget_range, input$status_filter)
  
  #Build Status list for query
  status_list <- paste0("'", input$status_filter, "'", collapse = ", ")
  
  #Build SQL query - counts how many crew memebers worked on each production and sprintf inserts into the query string
  query <- sprintf(
    "SELECT 
    p.Title, 
    p.Budget, 
    p.Status, 
    COUNT(pc.CrewID) AS CrewSize 
    FROM Productions p
    LEFT JOIN ProductionCrew pc ON p.ProductionID = pc.ProductionID 
    WHERE p.Budget BETWEEN '%s' AND '%s' 
      AND p.Status IN (%s)
    GROUP BY p.Title, p.Budget, p.Status
    ORDER BY p.Budget ASC",
    input$budget_range[1], 
    input$budget_range[2], 
    status_list
  )
  
# runs the query
  df <-dbGetQuery(conn, query)

# Creates plot using ggplot 
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = CrewSize, y = Budget, colour = Status, text = Title)) +
      geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) + 
      labs(title = "Budget vs Crew Size by Status",
           x = "Crew Size", y = "Budget") +
      theme_minimal()
    
# Shows information on hover
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("text", "x", "y"))
  
})}



# Launches the Shiny app
shinyApp(ui, server)

# Checks project status
renv::status()

# Disconnects from database 
dbDisconnect(conn)

```
